posts.title: How Hunt scores a find
posts.description: Hunt marks BUY, PASS, or CHECK from a verified sold price. Net is the sold price times 0.87 minus $5.
posts.body: Hunt is a website first. A find is BUY only when a verified sold price has a source URL and a date, and the net clears the bar. Net is the sold price times 0.87 minus $5. That net has to beat retail times 1.09 by at least $15, and the comp has to be liquid. A net under retail is PASS. Everything else is CHECK, including an ask with no settled sale. The calendar updates from brand and supplier feeds. Photos on a card and on detail pages are centered, and buy links are the way out to the store.

posts.title: Why some cards have no photo
posts.description: Hunt shows a product photo only from a licensed host. Logo images stay off the card.
posts.body: A product photo appears only when the license file names that host. Logo URLs are not shown. Unlicensed hosts stay as a category placeholder, including on detail pages. The operator is Broken Beaker Labs LC. The same rule covers Hot Wheels, trading cards, sneakers, and designer pieces.
